name: rfp021_attest

instructions.name: init
instructions.doc: Root -> instance PDA. Permissionless, once per instance_id; instance_id must equal sha256("rfp021/instance-id" || borsh(cfg) || trusted_block_root) and cfg must meet the floor (342 <= min_participation <= 512, ws_period_epochs <= 3558), else 1001. Bootstraps the light client, writes the first header + accumulator root.

instructions.name: update_begin
instructions.doc: Root -> instance PDA. lc-core prepare_update + BLS pre-work; sends WriteJob.

instructions.name: update_verify
instructions.doc: Root -> job PDA. Pairing check with the residue witness; consumes the job and sends Apply.

instructions.name: attest
instructions.doc: Root or chained -> header PDA. Verifies an Ethereum proof; replies to the caller (AttestReply) or emits the Attested event.

instructions.name: apply
instructions.doc: Internal: job -> instance PDA; applies the verified update, sends WriteHeader/WriteRoot.

instructions.name: write_header
instructions.doc: Internal: instance -> header PDA; immutable record.

instructions.name: check_root
instructions.doc: Root or chained -> header-root PDA. 1101 unless root was an accumulator root of the instance.

instructions.name: update
instructions.doc: Root -> instance PDA. Prepares, verifies the BLS residue witness and applies atomically; sends WriteHeader/WriteRoot. Same indexed non-signer hints and timestamp binding as UpdateBegin. Use UpdateBegin/UpdateVerify for updates exceeding the one-transaction gas budget.

instructions.name: check_header
instructions.doc: Root or chained -> header PDA. 1101 unless the header record exists for (instance_id, execution_block_hash); 1204 if its chain_id or genesis_validators_root differ. Binds the anchor for consumers that verify inline with verify_at (optional pattern, CONSUMER-GUIDE.md).

accounts.name: InstanceState
accounts.doc: instance PDA: seed sha256('rfp021/instance' || instance_id). Immutable cfg + lc-core Store + header accumulator.

accounts.name: HeaderRecord
accounts.doc: header PDA: seed sha256('rfp021/header' || instance_id || execution_block_hash). Write-once, immutable.

accounts.name: Job
accounts.doc: job PDA: seed sha256('rfp021/job' || instance_id || job_id u64 LE). Empty after UpdateVerify; the id can be reused.

accounts.name: HeaderRoot
accounts.doc: root PDA: seed sha256('rfp021/hroot' || instance_id || root). State = the 32-byte root, write-once.

errors.name: Malformed
errors.msg: Undecodable message, wrong receiver PDA, wrong/absent sender, or inconsistent input (incl. ancestry longer than MAX_ANCESTRY)

errors.name: ChainMismatch
errors.msg: Chain binding differs from the instance

errors.name: HeaderNotFinalised
errors.msg: Header/instance/root unknown (finality branch fails or no such PDA state)

errors.name: HandoffNotVerified
errors.msg: next_sync_committee branch fails or period gap

errors.name: UpdateNotNewer
errors.msg: Duplicate / already applied / older update, job id in use, or instance already initialised

errors.name: BootstrapMismatch
errors.msg: Bootstrap does not match the trusted block root

errors.name: ExecutionHeaderMismatch
errors.msg: keccak(exec_header_rlp) != execution_block_hash, or a broken ancestry link (keccak(H_i) != parentHash(H_i+1))

errors.name: PredicateFailed
errors.msg: A predicate does not hold on the proven fact

errors.name: StatementMismatch
errors.msg: Reply/statement does not match the pinned instance, chain or predicates

events.name: Attested
events.doc: Emitted by a root-call Attest (no caller actor to reply to).

notes: Hand-written for LEZ v0.4 actor-model programs (see docs/DECISIONS.md D-MOD-4). Types, variants, field order, error codes and seed tags are generated from the Rust source by idl/gen_idl.py; one wire message type per program, borsh-encoded, enum tag = variant_index (u8). Extra keys (variant_index, doc, internal, sender, events, callbacks, notes, seed transform) are outside SPEL's schema and ignored by its serde types. PDA derivation differs from SPEL's documented one: here seed = sha256(const tag bytes || each part's raw bytes) (u64 = 8 bytes LE, no zero-padding to 32), address = AccountId::for_public_pda(program, seed). 'transform: keccak256' = keccak256 of the argument. The instruction's single account is the RECEIVING actor; the sender (for internal messages) is checked in-guest.
